responsibility: Defines the target-type selection macros GCC uses when synthesizing <stdint.h> for targets that use newlib. It computes exact-width, least-width, fast-width, and pointer-sized integer type spellings from GCC size macros, including newlib-specific rules such as preferring 32-bit long on most targets and deriving uintptr_t from size_t while intptr_t follows ptrdiff_t. This header’s role is purely the libc ABI type model for generated stdint definitions, distinct from OS specs or driver behavior.
